pain_point: Want to own not rent for retirement - I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income
primary_text: "I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income." Every year you rent, you're building someone else's retirement asset while neglecting your own. Imagine this instead: you buy a new Truganina warehouse, operate from it for 15 years, and when you retire it's fully paid off. You lease it out on a 3+3 commercial lease and collect passive income while you travel, relax, or start your next chapter. Industrial vacancy rates in Melbourne's west are low and demand is strong. These off-the-plan warehouses on the Princes Freeway corridor are your business premises today and your retirement income tomorrow.
description: Low vacancy rates in Melbourne's west mean strong tenant demand at retirement
